question: What was the total number of goals scored in the finals of the FIFA World Cup 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Six was the total number of goals scored in the finals of the FIFA World Cup 2018**__.
 
• **France won the title by defeating Croatia by 4–2** in the final of the FIFA world cup played on 15 July 2018 at Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow.
 
• France received the distinction of becoming the World Cup winner for the second time under the captainship of Didier Deschamps.
 
• **2018 FIFA Men's World Cup was hosted by Russia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__ **

 
• FIFA stands for Federation of International Football Association.
 
 
• It is the highest governing body of Football.
 
• It was founded in 1904.
 
• Its headquarter is in Zurich, Switzerland.
 
• **President: Gianni Infantino**
